title: "Look! It's a Computer Program! It's an Algorithm! It's Al!”: Does Terminology Affect Human Perceptions and Evaluations of Algorithmic Decision-Making Systems?
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It measures how different terminologies for algorithmic decision-making (ADM) systems (e.g., 'algorithm', 'AI', 'computer program') affect laypeople's perceptions of system properties (e.g., complexity, trust, fairness) and their evaluations of system performance in secular contexts like hiring and work management.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
